content:
anya: quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: API / Console / Optimize timelines — collecting clarifications and actions here.
kevin: first Q: streaming GA for hosted API? we heard 'soon' but need dates to plan migrations.
maria: also need to know SDK parity for streaming (python/js) and example snippets.
anya: short answers: streaming beta will start in ~2 weeks; GA target mid-Q3 (~6 weeks after beta). python SDK will ship streaming at beta; js SDK follows in GA+2w.
alex: perf SLOs for streaming GA? e.g., p95 < 250ms for short responses on hosted.
anya: targets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 350ms for 0-128 token responses on hosted/dedicated. exact numbers and test harness in the release doc.
jeff: where's the rollout playbook / canary config? need to sync with support.
release-bot: Draft rollout playbook uploaded: https://redwood.internal/confluence/streams-rollout (edit access: eng, product).
dana: Console UI changes (model picker + streaming toggle) 1 freeze before GA?
maria: UI freeze = 72 hours for last non-critical tweaks, 7 days for infra toggles and backend flags. we'll announce final lock window 10 days before GA.
anya: action items: @kevin validate e2e streaming tests by Tue, @maria prepare SDK release notes and examples, @alex run perf suite on dedicated cluster and post results. I'll confirm canary capacity with infra.
kevin: got it, will prioritize test coverage.
maria: I'll draft the changelog and example snippets today.
alex: running perf spike now, will share p50/p95 and token distributions in #eng-runtime.
anya: Optimize (batching suggestions + quantization advisor) timeline: public beta end-of-month; GA ~6 weeks after beta. Console will show model-level cost deltas and suggested configs.
jeff: will Optimize show per-model cost delta numbers (FP16 vs INT8 etc.)? that would help product tradeoffs.
anya: yes, Optimize will surface per-model cost estimates and an "expected quality impact" note. examples will be in the docs.
release-bot: Reminder: sign off on pre-GA checklist in Confluence by EOD Friday.
anya: I'll consolidate schedule + changelog and post here tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
